concerns.text: The implementation plan relies exclusively on a SMILES‑only dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/maykcaldas/smiles-transformers/…) and explicitly states that the required joint SMILES + FQY dataset (FluorDB v1.0) is unavailable, yet the core scientific question – predicting experimental fluorescence quantum yields – fundamentally requires target values. This means FR‑018 (obtain a verified open dataset containing both SMILES strings and experimental FQY values) is not satisfied, and downstream functional requirements (FR‑010, FR‑011, FR‑015, FR‑005, FR‑006, FR‑007, FR‑008) cannot be executed. The plan therefore lacks an appropriate dataset to answer the research question.
